description: Agent-surface async fetch — prop city and action fetchForecast carry expose/describe so MCP agents can read and invoke them.
antiPatterns: Do not mark a mutating action expose: 'read' — the expose tier must match what the action does; fetchForecast writes state, so it is 'read write'.
Do not throw from an exposed action for ordinary failures — set an error state the agent can read back.

description: Accordion — each/key over prop-provided items, show toggles the open panel, aria-expanded tracks state.
antiPatterns: Do not drive frequently-toggled panels with if= — show keeps DOM and internal state alive; if= tears down and rebuilds.

description: Real-time clock — onMount starts the interval, onDispose clears it; tick runs through an action.
antiPatterns: Do not start timers at @state top level — setup also runs during SSR; start them in onMount and always clear them in onDispose.

description: controller() intrinsic — a ResizeObserver reactive controller with hostConnected/hostDisconnected lifecycle, writes routed through an action.
antiPatterns: Do not write state directly inside a controller body (C561) — controllers are derivations; route writes through an action.

description: Minimal reactive counter — prop-backed count with increment/decrement/reset actions.
antiPatterns: Do not reach for state() when the value is part of the component's public surface — prop() makes it host-settable and attribute-visible.

description: Modal dialog — aria() declares role/aria-modal on the host, show toggles visibility, Escape and backdrop click dismiss.
antiPatterns: Do not scatter role/aria-modal on inner wrappers — aria() declares them once on the host element.

description: Tabs — derived() computes the selected tab, each/key renders the tablist, onMount picks the initial tab.
antiPatterns: Do not recompute the active tab inline in the template — derived() memoizes the selection once for every read site.

description: Toast — auto-dismiss via onMount setTimeout, manual dismiss action, aria-live polite status region.
antiPatterns: Do not auto-dismiss without clearing the timer in onDispose — a disposed toast must not fire a dangling timeout.

description: Form-associated element — aria() maps role/label/describedby, form() exposes value and validity to the surrounding form.
antiPatterns: Do not mirror validity into ad-hoc CSS classes only — form() participates in real form submission and native :invalid styling.

description: consume() intrinsic — reads the 'theme' token provided by an ancestor context-provider.
antiPatterns: Do not resolve context in module scope — consume() resolves against the ancestor chain at setup time, not import time.

description: provide() intrinsic — exposes a theme token to descendant consumers over the context prototype chain.
antiPatterns: provide() must run during setup — do not call it inside onMount; descendants connecting during mount would miss the scope.

description: Sortable data table — derived() sorts a copy of the prop rows, each/key renders rows, click headers to toggle direction.
antiPatterns: Do not sort the prop array in place — [...rows].sort() keeps the source identity stable so the derivation re-runs cleanly.

description: resource() intrinsic — async fetch with loading/error/value states rendered through an if/elseif/else chain.
antiPatterns: Do not hand-roll loading/error state() flags around fetch inside an effect — resource() owns the loading/error/value lifecycle.

description: Live validation — form() exposes value/validity, derived() computes the error message, touched gates when errors show.
antiPatterns: Do not surface errors on every keystroke before first interaction — track touched so messages appear only after blur or input.

description: <guard> element — scope-gated UI that renders its children only when the 'admin' scope is verified.
antiPatterns: Do not treat <guard> as the security boundary — the server must enforce the same scope; the template guard is UX, not authorization.

description: Infinite scroll — controller() wires an IntersectionObserver sentinel that calls the loadMore action; each/key/empty renders the list.
antiPatterns: Do not fire loadMore from the observer without checking loading — re-entrant calls double-append pages.

description: Debounced search — bind:value feeds the query, effect() debounces 300ms into a second state, derived() filters results.
antiPatterns: Do not debounce inside derived() — derivations must be pure; the timer lives in effect(), the settled value in its own state.

description: SSR-safe bootstrapping — props render placeholders on the server; onMount reads server-stamped dataset values after hydration.
antiPatterns: Do not touch the DOM or dataset during setup — SSR executes setup on the server; DOM reads belong in onMount.

description: Tailwind utilities in the template coexisting with a scoped @style block for component-specific rules.
antiPatterns: Do not duplicate utility rules inside @style — the scoped block is for rules the utility layer cannot express.

description: Theme switcher — state-backed theme is provided to descendants and mirrored onto documentElement by an effect.
antiPatterns: Do not toggle document-level classes inside action bodies — the effect() re-runs whenever theme changes, keeping DOM and state in sync from one place.
